utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you mean the repair drive? I heard folks are still signing up—by afternoon, there’s usually a fresh list posted by the community board.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the list really gets posted by afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s right—by afternoon there’s usually a fresh list up on the community board.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check on the repair drive and let Noah know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check it and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can check the drive today. What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Afternoon works for me. Around 3?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 3 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve been hearing a lot about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I could use canned goods, medical tape, and a couple reliable hands for sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort donations and I’ll bring what canned goods I can find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I’ve checked the school schedule. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds good. I was thinking late afternoon, maybe around 4:30, if that works once you’ve checked the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 should work well for me once I’ve checked the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: tell me the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple it is. Saturday at 10, at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll be there Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Pia - I’m telling everyone I know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. Just make sure the pickup time and drop-off spot are clear so nobody gets stranded.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll make the pickup time and drop-off spot clear in every invite.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m only getting bits and pieces. Is there anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Bring any small tools you have, plus any spare screws, batteries, or broken items you want help with. I’ll make sure we sort out the rest at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll bring a few tools and check for any spare batteries or broken things I should mend.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I help, I want to confirm one detail: when does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts this Saturday morning at 9, right by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ll be there Saturday at 9 by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need a minute to sort out my side of things.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No rush, I can jump in and help once you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I’ll let you know when I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a few extra screwdrivers if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d help. Can you also tell me what time you’re coming by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can be there around 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and make sure we don’t lose track of it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll keep track of it too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, I’ll keep the repair drive location in mind and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a couple of spare tools in the shed, if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would help, thanks. I can take a look with you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, let’s start with the shed and see what we can use.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we need to be careful about timing and who can actually help with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can we confirm who’s actually available before we promise anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, let’s confirm availability first so we don’t overpromise on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help round up a few more hands for the repair drive if you need, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Jules. I’ll keep you posted on where we need folks most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’m glad to help. Just send me the spots where you need people, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare tarps and a box of screws if the drive still needs them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect timing — I can use those tarps and screws.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring them by now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Folks have been dropping off supplies all afternoon, so it’s moving along nicely. I heard they still need a few hands tomorrow if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help tomorrow after school for a bit, if that still counts as a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, that still counts — we could use the help, and tomorrow after school would be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What’s the next step?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll send around the repair list today and start matching folks to the open jobs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, send it my way and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. What needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s the repair drive itself. We need a quick fix on the latch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I can take a look at the latch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I heard about the repair drive — I can send folks your way if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help a lot. If you know anyone who can pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send anyone I know your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the repair drive is still by the side gate. I can point you to it if you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help, thanks. I’ll head over with you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll show you the way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, do you still need any help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check if there are any tools or materials still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up steam, so I’m glad to hear it. Let me know what still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira. I’ve got a couple things in mind, but I’ll need to check what’s left and make sure I’m not forgetting anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good - check what’s left, and I can help keep an eye out for anything missing.
